'''Falaco Don-DeMardo''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] general manager of the [[Marqua Spas]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gailea]]. After his assistant manager, [[Tarin DeHallo]], booked a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jantaa Binx|performer]] that shocked guests with a vulgar display of the [[Floubette dance]] at the [[Marqua Spas Grand Ball]], Don-DeMardo fired her.
